name: Credit event (hypothetical)
description: A corporate credit shock: corporate bond and liquid funds marked down, gilts unchanged, equities down 5%.
rationale: Exists because the 2018 IL&FS replay cannot show credit stress for our debt funds (see ilfs_2018_equity_drawdown and docs/data.md). The equity leg matches the Nifty 50 fall over the fortnight of the DHFL crash in our cache (2018-09-14 to 2018-09-28: -5.08%). The debt shocks are illustrative assumptions: our cache has no credit loss in these funds to calibrate them from. Gilts are set to 0 explicitly (a credit event, not a rate event) instead of letting a near-zero-R^2 factor beta decide.
caveats: Funds that actually held defaulted paper in 2018 marked it down by more than these magnitudes; the shocks describe a diversified fund, not one with a concentrated exposure.
The gold fund is not shocked directly and gets a factor-implied value that the result flags as unreliable.
